_comment: Landing 'Run the demo' scenario (D57 hand-off into the live console). Display and command data only: the console plays it through the normal /api/v1 fault endpoint with source 'demo', so status, diagnosis and 3D highlights come from the live pipeline, never from this file.
headline: Demo: oil pressure loss on the Rotax 912 iS Sport
steps: The fault is injected into the physics (oil pump health), not into the readings.
Watch oil pressure fall, the status move from GO towards NO-GO, and the reason name the limit.
Diagnosis lights the oil tank on the 3D engine once it is confident (training mode also outlines the injected part).
Clear the fault with 'Clear all' to watch the engine recover.
